result.title: Manifold-Constrained Initial Noise Optimization for Efficient Generative Model Alignment
result.summary: Recent advances in distillation and flow-map models have enabled deterministic one- or few-step generation for high-quality data, facilitating a new branch of reward alignment approaches that directly optimize the initial noise from a Gaussian distribution. However, most existing initial-noise optimization methods rely on first-order gradient information, which is either inapplicable or suffers from instability and inefficiency in black-box reward scenarios. Here, we introduce ZeNOVA, a stable and efficient initial noise alignment method in a gradient-free manner. Specifically, we address existing algorithms' major challenge in black-box scenarios through annealed soft-value guidance, manifold-constrained hyperspherical Langevin dynamics, and Metropolis-Hastings jumping. Extensive experiments on image and video generative models show that ZeNOVA outperforms all evaluated zeroth-order baselines by optimizing the initial noise toward higher rewards substantially more stably while exploiting the geometry of the Gaussian prior, demonstrating its practical applicability to various black-box reward alignment.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文提出 ZeNOVA，用退火软值引导、流形约束的超球面 Langevin 动力学与 Metropolis-Hastings 跳跃，在无梯度黑盒奖励下优化扩散/流映射模型的初始噪声以实现对齐。
AI.relevance_reason: 研究的是生成模型的初始噪声优化与奖励对齐，不涉及 VLM 推理状态、视觉证据使用或 latent 推理轨迹，与 LVR 主线缺少实质联系，仅“初始噪声状态搜索”一词面上相似。
